title: Flashcard draft returned by a model, before rendering

id.$comment: Present = update the existing card with this id. Absent = a new card; the CLI mints the id.

semantic_change.$comment: Only meaningful when updating. False keeps the card's review schedule; true drops it, because the card now asks something different and its history no longer describes it.

task_id.description: Copied verbatim from the emitted envelope — binds this answer to its task.

supplier.description: Attestation of who answered; recorded in the C6 artifact, never in notes.

proposer_overlap.description: true when the answering supplier also produced the material under judgment.

$comment: Cards absent from a draft are never deleted (.kb/POLICY.md) — they are reported so a human can decide.
